description:
Leaderboard of observed payer wallets in the x402 settlement graph, each
    with its intel score. This is behavioral corpus research, not identity
    proof or evidence that the wallet is a TWZRD customer.

    Ranks by the wash-discounted effective_score (single-counterparty fleets are
    demoted, not hidden) with a deterministic tiebreaker. Set min_paid_calls to
    suppress one-shot wallets and max_days_since_last to suppress dormant ones.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked payer wallets to return (default 10).
limit.title: Limit

max_days_since_last.description: Only include wallets active within this many days (default null = no recency filter). Use e.g. 14 to exclude dormant or historical payers.
max_days_since_last.title: Max Days Since Last

min_paid_calls.description: Filter out wallets with fewer than this many observed paid calls (default 0 = no filter). Use to get credible *active* counterparties, not a raw dump.
min_paid_calls.title: Min Paid Calls

name: get_top_intel_agents

agents.description: Ranked agent rows, each with intel_score, effective_score, wash fields, and rank.
agents.title: Agents

data_available.description: False when the corpus/DB was unavailable.
data_available.title: Data Available

error.description: Present only on the degraded path.
error.title: Error
